item.name: Fetch Factset Answer in Adaptive Card Format

request.name: Fetch Factset Answer in Adaptive Card Format

description.content: Returns an answer to the specified query (if valid answer exists) in the Adaptive Card format (https://adaptivecards.io/).

query.description: (Required) Query for desired answer (e.g., "fds price")
Includes thumbnail of Adaptive Card in response
Disables no-result answer responses (no-results and answer without data)
Theme for desired answer (e.g., "Light", "Dark")

Fetch Microsoft's Adaptive Cards, which includes headlines and event details data plus hyperlinks to FactSet reports, based on at least one of the following filtering parameters: `ids`, `portfolios`

query.description: A date/time (UTC) interval for filtering signal events based on their creation date. Defaults to NOW - 7 days if omitted. Users with limited access can only provide the default or a smaller date window.

Comma delimited string of identifiers. An identifier can be a ticker, FactSet entity id, CUSIP or ISIN. You must provide a list of identifiers either via a ids or a portfolios parameter. If both are provided, only ids filter is used. Users with limited access can use only the ids filter and provide at most 10 ids.

Name of a portfolio file stored by FactSet. If the portfolio contains more than 1,000 ids, only the first 1,000 ids are processed (e.g. client:techstocks.ofdb). Please note that using this parameter requires full subscription to Signals API.
Comma delimited string of theme ids. Full list of signal themes can be viewed at /themes.
Comma delimited string of category ids. Full list of signal categories can be viewed at /categories.

Comma delimited string of sortable attributes. The sort order for each sort attribute is ascending unless it is prefixed with a minus sign, in which case it is descending. If sort is not provided, the default sort applied is -userRelevanceScore (userRelevanceScore in descending order).
The api will return resolved identifiers in the meta section of the response by default (true). If the parameter is false, the api will not attempt to resolve the identifiers.
